title: Outside sound sources: sample libraries, impulse responses, recorded effects
rule: Only sources whose licence allows use in a monetised YouTube series. Licence wording copied from the source page or the licence file shipped with the download (checked 28 Nov 2026). Large files live in the scratchpad, never in git; fetch with production/tools/music/fetch_libs_v3.sh and production/tools/sfx/fetch_fx_e01.sh.

libraries.name: Versilian Community Sample Library (VCSL), 'sfz' branch
libraries.licence_wording: This collection is under a Creative Commons 0 license. Essentially it's Public Domain- you can do whatever you want with these sounds (even make commercial software), no royalties, no credit, no special terms.
libraries.credit: Versilian Community Sample Library (CC0) - credit optional; we credit it in the end titles' music line.
libraries.used: Kawai grand piano, marimba, vibraphone, xylophone, glockenspiel, kalimba (Kenya), concert harp, darbuka, frame drum, cajon, conga, bongos, snare, hi-hat, bass drum, tom, suspended cymbal, triangles, shaker, woodblock, slapstick, flexatone, ratchet, vibraslap, guiro, claves, finger cymbals, Nepalese hand bells, mark trees, toy train whistle; also fetched: balafon, dan tranh, folk harp

in_house: All other effects are synthesised in production/tools/sfx/*.py (sfxlib) and the placeholders in production/tools/edit/audio.py; all score is composed in production/tools/music/*.py.
source_ruling_28nov: Showrunner ruling: any source that is free to obtain and whose terms do not forbid use in published music (PD, CC0, CC BY with credit, royalty-free-for-productions, open university sets, no-redistribution-as-samples). Not allowed: packs whose terms forbid commercial use; instruments ripped from commercial recordings. Thin terms are marked 'terms thin - swap if a better source appears'.

in_house_instruments.note: No outside samples. Models: Karplus-Strong string with one-sided bridge contact (jawari) and sympathetic-string resonator bank; additive harmonic wind/bowed engine with harmonic-locked breath/bow noise and body formants; modal membrane strokes with pitch glide.

in_house_effects_processing: production/tools/sfx/fx3.py layers and processes the effects already listed here (our synth files + the CC0 Freesound recordings); no new outside sources in stage 1.
